nodes.label: Claim Verified and Accepted

ambiguities.text: There is no way to prove who is in control using on chain data in contested claim scenarios
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume contested claims require out-of-band resolution through social consensus. The protocol cannot cryptographically resolve ownership disputes.

ambiguities.text: Nodes 'shall reject accepting or rebroadcasting messages which do not match' but behavior for validators not in broadcast file is unclear
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume messages for validators without broadcast file entries are treated as normal (accepted), since no preference exists. Only conflicts trigger rejection.

ambiguities.text: No specification for how long node operators should maintain the broadcast file filtering after Capella activation
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume filtering should persist indefinitely or until all broadcast file entries are processed on-chain.

implicit_assumptions.description: Node operators will voluntarily load and honor the broadcast file filtering behavior
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Without widespread node operator participation, the protection mechanism has no effect and attackers can freely propagate conflicting messages.

implicit_assumptions.description: Legitimate key holders will submit their claims before Capella activation
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If legitimate holders fail to submit claims, attackers who have compromised deposit keys will win the race at Capella activation.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot compromise both the execution layer deposit key and the consensus layer BLS key simultaneously
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If attacker controls both keys, there is no cryptographic evidence to distinguish attacker from legitimate owner.

implicit_assumptions.description: Community repository verification is performed correctly and honestly
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious or negligent verification could allow invalid claims into the broadcast file, causing legitimate messages to be filtered.
